name: SOC-010: System Integrity Violation
description: Detects system integrity violations including kernel module loading and rootkit installation indicators.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%LinuxServer%' AND (payload ILIKE '%insmod%' OR payload ILIKE '%modprobe%' OR payload ILIKE '%/boot/grub%' OR payload ILIKE '%/lib/modules%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
